description: This source file defines React hooks for managing and performing search-related state in a video streaming platform. It includes hooks to access current search state and to dispatch actions for updating query, results, loading status, and errors, along with a stub implementation of a search operation that generates mock search results.

methods.name: useSearchState()
methods.description: Hook that returns current search state including query, results, loading status, error, and result count.

methods.name: useSearchActions()
methods.description: Hook that provides memoized functions to update search query, results, loading status, error, and perform a mock search operation.
